lines: If you think you're just bad at studying, watch this.
Two students. Same class. Same chapter.
So what did the one-hour student do, that the six-hour student didn't?
It's not talent. And it's not time.
The six-hour student reread the chapter three times. Every page felt familiar.
But familiar isn't the same as remembered.
The one-hour student closed the book, and quizzed themself every few pages.
Every time you pull an answer out of your own head, it sticks a little harder.
And that's exactly what the test asks you to do.
If your test isn't until Friday, you still have the chance.
But here's what most people do instead.
All of it is just more reading.
Unspool turns your chapter into short reels.
And every reel ends with a quiz, so you're pulling it out, not just reading it.
Miss one, and it tells you why.
Try it at unspool dot c c. Your first reel is free.
Try it at unspool.cc. Your first reel is free.
